# f5xc_global_log_receiver (Resource)

Global Log Receiver is used to specify a receiver (s3 bucket, etc.) for periodic streaming of access logs

To get more information about f5xc_global_log_receiver, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/global-log-receiver)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Global Log Receiver - Full

resource "f5xc_global_log_receiver" "example" {
  name        = "example-global-log-receiver"
  namespace   = "system"
  description = "Full global log receiver example"

  filter_choice = {
    ns_list = {
      namespaces = ["default"]
    }
  }

  log_type_choice = {
    request_logs = {
      sampling_choice = {
        sampled = true
      }
    }
  }

  receiver_choice = {
    http_receiver = {
      auth_choice = {
        auth_none = true
      }
      tls_choice = {
        no_tls = true
      }
      uri = "http://example.com:9000/logs"
    }
  }

  labels = {
    env = "example"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "platform-team"
  }
}
```

### Nested Schema for `receiver_choice.datadog_receiver.datadog_api_key`

Required:

Optional:

- `blindfold_secret_info` (Attributes) Blindfold Secret Blindfold Secret is used for the secrets managed by F5XC Secret Management Service<br>Conflicts with `clear_secret_info` and `none`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--receiver_choice--datadog_receiver--datadog_api_key--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info))
- `clear_secret_info` (Attributes) Clear Secret Clear Secret is used for the secrets that are not encrypted<br>Conflicts with `blindfold_secret_info` and `none`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--receiver_choice--datadog_receiver--datadog_api_key--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info))

Not suitable for TLS or any use case that requires presenting a certificate, those will fail without a private key.<br>Conflicts with `blindfold_secret_info` and `clear_secret_info`.

<a id="nestedatt--receiver_choice--datadog_receiver--datadog_api_key--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info"></a>

Required:

Optional:

- `decryption_provider` (String) Decryption Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the backend Secret Management service.
- `store_provider` (String) Store Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///


<a id="nestedatt--receiver_choice--datadog_receiver--datadog_api_key--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info"></a>

Required:

Optional:

- `provider` (String) Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///

- `auth_choice` (Attributes) HTTP Authentication Method HTTP Authentication Method controls how to authenticate to the HTTP endpoint<br>Exactly one of `auth_basic`, `auth_none`, or `auth_token` must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--receiver_choice--http_receiver--auth_choice))
- `tls_choice` (Attributes) Enable TLS<br>Exactly one of `no_tls` or `use_tls` must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--receiver_choice--http_receiver--tls_choice))
- `uri` (String) HTTP Uri HTTP Uri is the Uri of the HTTP endpoint to send logs to, example: `http://example.com:9000/logs`

Optional:

- `batch` (Attributes) Batch Options Batch Options allow tuning of the conditions for how batches of logs are sent to the endpoint (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--receiver_choice--http_receiver--batch))
- `compression` (Attributes) Compression Options Compression Options allows selection of how data should be compressed when sent to the endpoint (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--receiver_choice--http_receiver--compression))

<a id="nestedatt--receiver_choice--http_receiver--auth_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `receiver_choice.http_receiver.auth_choice`

Optional:

- `auth_basic` (Attributes) Basic Authentication Use HTTP Basic Auth for authentication to the HTPP(s) server<br>Conflicts with `auth_none` and `auth_token`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--receiver_choice--http_receiver--auth_choice--auth_basic))
- `auth_none` (Boolean) No Authentication No Authentication<br>Conflicts with `auth_basic` and `auth_token`.
- `auth_token` (Attributes) Token Authentication Configure an Access Token for authentication to the HTTP(s) server (such as a Bearer Token)<br>Conflicts with `auth_basic` and `auth_none`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--receiver_choice--http_receiver--auth_choice--auth_token))

<a id="nestedatt--receiver_choice--http_receiver--auth_choice--auth_basic"></a>
### Nested Schema for `receiver_choice.http_receiver.auth_choice.auth_basic`

Optional:

- `password` (Attributes) password HTTP Basic Auth Password (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--receiver_choice--http_receiver--auth_choice--auth_basic--password))
- `user_name` (String) username HTTP Basic Auth User Name<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(64)`<br>**Default:** ``

<a id="nestedatt--receiver_choice--http_receiver--auth_choice--auth_basic--password"></a>
### Nested Schema for `receiver_choice.http_receiver.auth_choice.auth_basic.password`

Required:

- `secret_info_choice` (Attributes) SecretInfoOneof Secret can be one of the following types - * Blindfold Secret - Secret is managed by F5XC Secret Management System * Clear Secret - Secret is not encrypted<br>Exactly one of `blindfold_secret_info`, `clear_secret_info`, or `none` must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--receiver_choice--http_receiver--auth_choice--auth_basic--password--secret_info_choice))

<a id="nestedatt--receiver_choice--http_receiver--auth_choice--auth_basic--password--secret_info_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `receiver_choice.http_receiver.auth_choice.auth_basic.password.secret_info_choice`

Optional:

- `blindfold_secret_info` (Attributes) Blindfold Secret Blindfold Secret is used for the secrets managed by F5XC Secret Management Service<br>Conflicts with `clear_secret_info` and `none`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--receiver_choice--http_receiver--auth_choice--auth_basic--password--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info))
- `clear_secret_info` (Attributes) Clear Secret Clear Secret is used for the secrets that are not encrypted<br>Conflicts with `blindfold_secret_info` and `none`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--receiver_choice--http_receiver--auth_choice--auth_basic--password--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info))
- `none` (Boolean) None No private key will be stored or used. Choose this only when you need a public certificate for verification (e.g., validating SAML/JWT signatures). Not suitable for TLS or any use case that requires presenting a certificate, those will fail without a private key.<br>Conflicts with `blindfold_secret_info` and `clear_secret_info`.

Optional:

- `decryption_provider` (String) Decryption Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the backend Secret Management service.
- `store_provider` (String) Store Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///

Required:

- `url` (String, Sensitive) URL URL of the secret. Currently supported URL schemes is string:///. For string:/// scheme, Secret needs to be encoded Base64 format. When asked for this secret, caller will get Secret bytes after Base64 decoding.

Optional:

- `provider` (String) Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///

Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_global_log_receiver.example <namespace>/<name>
```

#### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl
import {
	id = "<namespace>/<name>"
	to = f5xc_global_log_receiver.example
}
```
